currentRoundInspection.scope: Detached eastern latrine surviving octagonal masonry only, on its own exact mapped footprint beside the basilica. Low broad rubble walls, irregular broken caps, a reconstructed west-facing entrance gap toward the main villa and a genuinely open center retain original ground. No speculative intact ancient roof, invented conservation canopy, mosaic copy, furnishings, benches or underground plumbing. Main villa, Triclinium, Xystus, entrance and polygonal latrine remain independent.
